item.title: Semi-truck dangles over I-5 bridge in Oceanside; incident blocks lanes
item.description: A semi tractor-trailer crash has blocked multiple lanes on northbound I-5 in Oceanside, causing traffic delays and impacting northbound I-5 and westbound State Route 76.

item.title: San Diego Unified leaders push for funding in Sacramento ahead of one-day strike
item.description: San Diego Unified School District (SDUSD) leaders met with state leaders in Sacramento Wednesday to press for funding for special education and early intervention programs.

item.title: Fatal collision in Crest leaves one driver dead, closes La Cresta Road
item.description: A fatal crash at La Cresta Road and Mountain View Road in the Crest area on Wednesday afternoon left the driver of a sedan dead, and La Cresta Road closed for an unknown duration.

item.title: Kristi Noem to address border security at Otay Mesa press conference
item.description: Secretary of Homeland Security Kristi Noem will hold a press conference in Otay Mesa on Thursday to discuss the Trump Administration's border security and drug-seizure efforts, joined by Chief of the United States Border Patrol Mike Banks and Customs and Border Protection officials.

item.title: Photo released of car involved in deadly PB hit-and-run
item.description: Crime Stoppers has released photo of a suspect's car involved in a deadly hit-and-run in Pacific Beach.

item.title: Suspect in I-15 crash had outstanding warrant
item.description: A woman with an outstanding warrant was arrested after a two-hour police chase on the I-15 freeway, during which she hit multiple vehicles and nearly while driving erratically with a dog in the front passenger seat.

item.title: Student detained on suspicion of making multiple threats at middle school in Poway
item.description: A student at Meadowbrook Middle School was detained on Wednesday for allegedly making criminal threats after sending emails and a video to school staff and students.

item.title: Semi-truck crash, fuel spill on I-15 blocks traffic near Mission Valley
item.description: Some lanes of Interstate 15 in San Diego have been blocked off to traffic due to a semi-truck that spun out and leaked diesel fuel and oil onto the roadway.

item.title: Hundreds of Chula Vista educators fight for better health care coverage as costs surge
item.description: Chula Vista Educators are calling on the district to address rising health insurance premiums, which have increased by $300-$400 per month, forcing some teachers to drop their coverage altogether.

item.title: America’s top Admiral says leadership starts at home
item.description: Admiral Daryl Caudle, the 34th Chief of Naval Operations, has made it his priority to invest in sailors and their families, believing that taking care of them directly translates into readiness, and has emphasized the importance of mental health care for sailors.
